# 1001 Dapp Lego Blocks

> Agent entrypoint for choosing and using 1001 dapp building blocks.

This file routes agents to the right 1001 block for each dapp-building task.
Detailed implementation guidance lives in `blocks/*.md`.

## Guides

- [Layers](blocks/layers.md): Nuxt/Vue app foundation, EVM UX, components, styles.
- [Data](blocks/data.md): resilient on-chain data queries.
- [Metadata](blocks/metadata.md): decentralized resource fetching and NFT metadata normalization.
- [Indexing](blocks/indexing.md): browser/server event indexing and Ponder caches.
- [Contracts](blocks/contracts.md): NFT extensions and Solidity helpers.
- [Contract Intelligence](blocks/contract-intelligence.md): proxy detection and NatSpec.
- [Wallet Auth](blocks/wallet-auth.md): in-app wallets and SIWE sessions.
- [Infra](blocks/infra.md): deployable IPFS infrastructure.
